comment: Role table for spawn.py. A role sets the tab, the session type and the usual file access. It sets no model and removes no tool. The tools and skills of a role come from resources.json. spawn.py applies hard tool limits only with --strict.

coordinator.focus: Plans the work, delegates it, checks the results, reports to the user.

researcher.focus: Context gatherer. Web research first: sources outside the machine, with citations. Local search when the task needs it.

scout.focus: Context gatherer. Local search first: files, repositories and their history. Web access for a repository or the documentation of an app when the task needs it.

worker.focus: Implements one bounded change and verifies it.

reviewer.focus: Reviews a plan, a diff or code. Reports defects with evidence. Changes nothing.

launch.comment: Files that spawn.py gives to a harness. {skill} is the directory of this skill. ~ is the home directory. An empty value means not set. The launch object of the machine file ~/.config/herdr-skill/resources.json replaces a value for one machine. pi_mcp_config_strict: an MCP configuration file that a pi session with web access gets with --strict. Claude Code needs no file here: spawn.py writes its MCP configuration from the mcp entries of the catalog.
